entrypoints.summary: A third-party page frames the web-accessible Rich Text Editor and presents a drag-and-drop game containing attacker-controlled HTML; the illustrated frame URL relies on predictable GET parameters.
The victim drops the supplied HTML into the textarea-based editor and clicks Transfer, causing its contents to be copied to the webmail provider compose container.

observability.channel: Browser JavaScript dialog and execution origin
negative_controls: No execution result from an isolated regression test or live run is included in the bundle.
observability.positive_marker: The supplied alert(document.domain) payload is reported to execute in the mail.google.com context in Gmail.

preconditions: The assessed showModalDialog-branch Rich Text Editor is frameable from a third-party page.
The proof of concept relies on predictable GET parameters for the Rich Text Editor frame URL.
A victim participates in the drag-and-drop game and clicks Transfer.

trigger_steps.payload_shape: HTML markup with an img element whose onerror handler invokes alert(document.domain).

trigger_steps.payload_shape: The transferred textarea contents are inserted into the provider's contenteditable compose element.
trigger_steps.summary: Have the victim drag the selected HTML into the editor and click Transfer.

sources.concept: Attacker-controlled HTML delivered through a UI-redressed drag-and-drop Rich Text Editor

impact.affected_asset: Webmail-provider origin and compose-session DOM, specifically demonstrated for mail.google.com
impact.attacker_capability: Cause a socially engineered victim to transfer attacker-supplied markup that executes script in the provider context
impact.security_effect: Cross-site scripting and UI spoofing in the webmail provider origin

causal_trace.summary: A malicious third-party page UI-redresses a frameable Rich Text Editor and supplies HTML containing an img element with an onerror handler through a drag-and-drop game.
Plain text accepted by the editor crosses into the provider-owned compose DOM without entity encoding or whitelist sanitization, so it is no longer guaranteed to remain inert text.
Transfer copies the editor contents into a webmail-provided container exemplified as a contenteditable div, where the provider interprets transferred text as HTML.
The supplied img/onerror payload executes and enables XSS/UI spoofing in the webmail-provider context; the report specifically identifies mail.google.com for Gmail.

failure.operation: Copying unsanitized editor content through Transfer into the webmail provider compose container

primary_invariant.statement: Content transferred from the Rich Text Editor to a webmail provider compose DOM must be encoded or sanitised such that attacker-controlled plaintext is inert rather than provider-interpreted markup.
primary_invariant.violated_because: The Transfer operation copied textarea content into a contenteditable provider container without HTML entity encoding or a whitelist-based filter.

raw_refs.role: canonical audit finding, proof of concept, and stated resolution

quality.review_notes: The primary audit report contains a concrete interaction sequence, payload, stated Gmail-origin execution outcome, recommendations, and a reported sanitizer-based resolution. No historical source snapshot, patch diff, version-to-fix mapping, regression test, or independent execution transcript is present; the report concerns an alpha-era showModalDialog branch and does not establish current-version exposure. Frameability/predictable GET parameters are proof-of-concept preconditions rather than universal assumptions.

remediation.invariant_restored: Content copied to the webmail provider is encoded or restricted by a whitelist filter so attacker-controlled markup cannot be interpreted as executable HTML.
mitigation_classes: HTML entity encoding at the transfer boundary
filtering at paste, drop, and Transfer ingress points

affected_versions_or_commits.value: showModalDialog branch assessed by Cure53 during the 2012-12 to 2013-02 alpha-era assessment

target.component: Rich Text Editor in the showModalDialog branch and its transfer into the webmail compose element
